qualification: Prepared configuration; no Thor execution was performed on the Spark host.
hostPolicy: Verify Connect Tech BSP support first. Do not flash or change the target's existing BSP from this preparation workflow.
memoryPolicy: Preserve the actual target's saved .thor/settings.json reserve and active guard. Do not initialize or lower it from Spark.
enginePolicy: Rebuild from the pinned ONNX on the actual Thor GPU and record its local build and inference receipts. Never copy the Spark TensorRT engine or native binaries.
requiredChecks: Actual Anvil-T5 BSP, JetPack, driver and selected DeepStream package compatibility
Compiler and CUDA build tooling in the chosen Jetson build environment
Linear CUDA RGBA input, GPU conversion/copy and CUDA NvDCF memory paths
Target-specific hardware decode and bounded CPU fallback if explicitly configured
Two actual RTSP sources, frame clock alignment, rule reloads and evidence
Concurrent Cosmos/semantic services and saved-reserve endurance
